label: PF Backlog 624
title: Artifact contracts: product-wide DRY (state NFRs/quality once, not per feature)
body: Deduplicate cross-cutting content: NFRs/quality/security stated product-wide once; per-feature artifacts reference by id. Separate concern from BI-PF-1347.

analysis.implementation_strategy: Extend core/contracts.py + core/artifact_registry.py to support a 'product-wide' shared artifact section registry: NFRs/quality/security defined once as canonical blocks with ids, emitted from config/artifact-formats.json. Per-feature artifact templates reference blocks via {{ref:<id>}} tokens resolved at generation and validate_artifact time. Extend /api/v1/validation/artifact-contracts to verify every referenced id exists and no per-feature duplication of shared blocks is present.

dependency_findings.required_state: outline gate stable so reference tokens resolve before prose fill

conflict_findings: Concurrent edits to core/contracts.py and config/artifact-formats.json with BI-PF-1347
duplication_findings: BI-PF-1347 already bundles 'product-wide DRY' — scope must be carved out to avoid duplicate implementation
core/quality_metrics.py and core/contracts.py both touch quality requirements; consolidate emission through contracts.py
analysis.rationale: DRY-ing cross-cutting content reduces drift and token cost across artifacts; existing contracts/registry/format config provide a natural extension point with no new component needed. Scope must be explicitly separated from BI-PF-1347 to avoid duplicate work.
assumptions: Artifact formats are already declarative in config/artifact-formats.json
validate_artifact is the single validation entrypoint
Per-feature artifacts already carry stable ids via artifact_registry
risks: Reference-token resolution could break existing generated artifacts lacking ids
Overlapping scope with BI-PF-1347 may cause merge conflicts
Shared-block registry may over-constrain features needing local NFR variance
evidence: config/artifact-formats.json is the declarative source of truth
missing_info: Canonical list of product-wide sections to deduplicate (NFRs, quality, security, others?)
Whether per-feature local overrides of shared blocks are permitted
Sequencing decision vs BI-PF-1347 (split or block)
Id namespace and reference token syntax

context_review.reason: Title/objective/approach/acceptance are all circular restatements of the goal; no concrete reference-id mechanism, schema/format, or files/components specified; where fields say 'Not specified.'
